entries.content: Office hours are Monday–Friday 9:00–18:00 local time. After hours, leave a WhatsApp message and Lysa will help or escalate.
We start with a short qualification, share matching listings, then book showings. An agent joins for offers and negotiation.
Buyer-side representation is typically covered by the listing side where customary; confirm specifics with a licensed agent before signing.
We focus on Greater Phoenix including Scottsdale, Tempe, and Mesa. Ask about other areas and we will check coverage.

listings.title: Sunny 3-bed in Scottsdale
listings.description: Updated kitchen, private backyard, close to Old Town. Ideal for first-time buyers under $700k.

listings.title: Modern Tempe townhome
listings.description: Gated community, 2-car garage, walkable to shops. Low-maintenance living near ASU.

listings.title: Family home in Mesa
listings.description: Four bedrooms, large lot, quiet cul-de-sac. Great for growing families.
